title: Promises and proofs
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: contracts say what's promised; tests prove it, and are written first. Every gap between what the business expects and what the sources hold gets a decision.
howto: White lines on blue are the model; code on dark glass is the project, and the small label beside it says where it runs. Green is a test that passed, amber a warning, red a test that stopped the build, and a hollow dot a test not yet run. Teal is an AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval.
